page.layout: One column of text, dictionary entries in Latin with Hebrew words, running from top to bottom. Page number at top left. Running head at top centre. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Accinctus, Psal.65.7. Pih. אזר, Futur: וַתְּזְרֵנִי Et accinges me, 2.Sam.22.40. pro וַתְּאַזְרֵנִי ut pro eo legitur, Psal.18.40. Hithp.Præt. הִתְאַזֵּר Accingit se, Psal.93.1. Imp. הִתְאַזְּרוּ Accingimini, Iesa.8.9.

אח f. Focus: וְאֵת הָאֵשׁ לִפְנֵי מְבַעֵרֶת Et focus coram ipso ardebat, Jer.36.22. Item Ah, Heu; Ezech.6.11. & 21.v.15. Dolentis & gemetis, quasi ab אנח vel pro אח guttu-ralib. ה & ח commutatis: Vide & mox in אחד, & in אחה.
האח Euge, Psal.35.21. Vox gestientis & insultantis pra laetitia, unde Chaldaeus plerunq; eam vertit חֲדְוָא Laetitia, ut Ezech.36.2. Job.39.28.

אחד m. Unus, Quidam, Primus: Per Apocopam אח Unum, juxta R.David. Ezech.18.10. vel est Frater, juxta Targum, ab אחה ex forma Chaldaica. Per Aphæresin, חד Ezech.33.30. Chald. חד צלם Imago una, Dan.2.31. Fœm. בשנת חדה In anno primo, Esr.5. v.13. כשעה חדא Quasi hora una, Dan.4.16. נחדרי Simul, Una, Pariter, Dan.2.35. Plur. אחדים Uni, id est, idem, Genes.11.1. Pauci, Gen.27.44. & 29.20. אחדים In una, id est, unita, Ezech.37.17. Fœm. אחת, & ad accentus pausantes אחה Una, contractum ex masc. pro אחדה, ut docet Aben Esra, Exod.26.7. Hinc verbum in Kal pro Unire, Adunare se; unde possit esse Futur. תחד, quod vide in יחד. Hithp: התאחדי Uni te, Ezech.21.16.

אח m. Frater; Propinquus, Agnatus, Cognatus, & qui eadè professione, gente, morib. vel amicitiâ frater est. Pro Agnato, ut Lotho, Gen.14.14. qui v.12. dicitur fuisse filius fratris Abrahami: Pro Gentili, Lev.25.46. Pro Quolibet proximo, Lev.19.17. & Fratre moribus

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from a small, blurred scan; vowel points and dagesh are uncertain and marked [?] where doubtful. The entries "אוּחַ" and "חוד" after "Vide" and "Vide in" are read from a faint line and not certain. "guttu-ralib." is partly obscured. The catchword at bottom right is faint and only partly legible. The Hebrew headword "אח" for "Frater" and the headwords of other entries are printed in larger type; they are treated as entry words within the text, not as headings. The line "Pro Quolibet proximo" was in larger type in the scan and may be a heading-like entry line, but it is kept as running text.
